headline_item.title_zh: 思科与OpenAI启动开源基础设施防护计划
headline_item.title_en: Cisco and OpenAI launch Shirudo open-source infrastructure shield to prevent AI-driven cyberattacks
headline_item.author: Mike Wheatley
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 思科与OpenAI联手发布安全基础设施项目及Shirudo工具，旨在应对AI加速带来的“零日”自动化网络攻击
headline_item.event_summary_en: Cisco's VP of Engineering and Security CTO Thomas Graf has partnered with OpenAI to launch the 'Secure Infrastructure Project,' featuring an open-source tool called Shirudo that utilizes immutable architecture and reinforcement learning for proactive defense. This initiative addresses the critical threat where AI-driven vulnerability exploitation precedes public disclosure, shifting security from reactive patching to resilient, design-based protection.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】思科系统工程副总裁兼安全CTO Thomas Graf、OpenAI集团在企业级安全基础设施构建领域：发布安全基础设施项目，并推出Shirudo开源防御工具
【起因与机理】应对AI驱动的网络攻击导致漏洞修复周期失效的现实风险
【关键技术规格】核心动因：应对AI驱动的自动化漏洞挖掘与负向防御时间窗口。
【行业影响与走向】后续影响：推动行业从补丁式安全向设计即安全（Secure-by-Design）转型。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Thomas Graf (VP of Engineering and Security CTO at Cisco Systems), OpenAI Group PBC: Launch of the Secure Infrastructure Project and the Shirudo open-source tool
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To counter the threat of AI-driven cyberattacks that outpace traditional manual patching
[Key Fact Detail] Core driver: Addressing the negative time window for vulnerability exploitation caused by AI-driven automation.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Future impact: Shifting the industry toward a 'Secure-by-Design' paradigm instead of reactive patching.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 安全防御逻辑正从“漏洞修补”向“架构免疫”范式转移，此合作标志着传统网络巨头开始通过集成AI原生的防御模型来重塑云原生算力边界。Shirudo通过强化学习实现的自我防御机制，将显著提高算力平台的防御韧性，这可能迫使云服务提供商重构其底层TPM（可信平台模块）信任链以满足合规审计要求。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: Security paradigms are shifting from reactive patching to architecture-based immunity, with this collaboration marking the integration of AI-native defense models into legacy network infrastructure. By leveraging reinforcement learning for self-defense, Shirudo forces a re-evaluation of TPM-based trust chains, likely setting a new standard for cloud-native infrastructure security.

headlines.title_zh: OpenAI发布GPT-6.2 Sol并淘汰两款旧模型
headlines.title_en: ChatGPT expands GPT-6.2 Sol as OpenAI sets retirement date for two models
headlines.author: Zac Hall
headlines.event_summary_zh: OpenAI向全线付费用户推出GPT-6.2 Sol模型，强化视觉与网页搜索能力，并定于12月23日下架GPT-5.6 Sol与Terra模型
headlines.event_summary_en: OpenAI has deployed the GPT-6.2 Sol model across all subscription tiers, featuring enhanced multimodal recognition and cross-application task execution. Simultaneously, the company scheduled the retirement of GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-5.6 Terra for December 23, aiming to accelerate the streamlining of its model ecosystem.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】OpenAI：发布GPT-6.2 Sol模型并计划于12月23日淘汰GPT-5.6系列旧模型
【起因与机理】通过提升多模态感知与任务执行能力，优化用户交互体验并整合产品算力资源
【关键技术规格】全面升级至GPT-6.2 Sol模型，提升网页交互及视觉细节分析能力。
【涉及范围与推进】覆盖全线订阅用户，推动模型性能标准化与算力整合。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] OpenAI: Released GPT-6.2 Sol and announced the retirement of GPT-5.6 series models by Dec 23
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To improve multimodal perception and task execution, thereby optimizing UX and consolidating compute resources
[Key Technical Spec] Deployment of GPT-6.2 Sol with improved visual and search capabilities.
[Key Position & Outlook] Global rollout across all ChatGPT premium tiers for unified performance.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: OpenAI此举标志着模型迭代周期的进一步压缩，旨在通过强制迁移减少长尾模型的维护成本与算力分摊。这种高频率的“以新换旧”策略不仅是功能升级，更是通过控制模型版本收敛，确立其在Agent交互领域的技术统治标准。
headlines.industry_impact_en: OpenAI's strategy signals a compression of model iteration cycles, leveraging forced migration to reduce maintenance overhead and compute fragmentation. By tightly controlling version convergence, OpenAI is effectively setting industry standards for agentic interaction performance.

headlines.title_zh: 黄仁勋卸任引发市场震荡与白宫合规危机
headlines.title_en: Jensen Huang Is a White House Scandal
headlines.author: Amrith Ramkumar and Josh Dawsey and C. Ryan Barber and Robbie Whelan
headlines.event_summary_zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋因私人行为指控辞职，特朗普政府正介入调查其合规性与国家安全关联以稳定AI市场
headlines.event_summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned following revelations of affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset, triggering market instability. President Donald Trump has intervened, with Attorney General Todd Blanche confirming that Huang is not currently a target of DOJ investigations, aimed at stabilizing the AI supply chain and capital market sentiment.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】黄仁勋（英伟达前CEO）、唐纳德·特朗普（美国总统）、托德·布兰奇（美国司法部长）在美国资本市场与白宫行政权力中心：黄仁勋辞职引发英伟达股价动荡，白宫试图介入排除国家安全违规风险
【起因与机理】因私人关系涉及疑似间谍活动及公司治理丑闻，引发美国政府对关键芯片产业供应链安全的担忧
【关键数据与实测】Two days before the meeting, Trump's money managers bought between $1 million and $5 million in Nvidia stock.。
【行业影响与走向】特朗普政府担忧英伟达资产变动对AI产业链的系统性影响。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Jensen Huang (Former Nvidia CEO), Donald Trump (US President), Todd Blanche (US Attorney General): Huang's resignation destabilized Nvidia stock; the administration is intervening to decouple personal scandals from national security risks
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Allegations of connections to foreign intelligence and internal conduct violations threatened the stability of the US AI hardware backbone
[Key Metrics] And by the end of last year, Nvidia had become one of Trump's three largest individual stock holdings, worth between $12.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] White House monitoring Nvidia's systemic impact on AI supply chain.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此事件标志着AI产业核心战略资产的掌舵人风险已溢出为国家安全层面的监管重塑，英伟达作为美国AI基础设施的唯一支柱，其高管治理结构将成为后续地缘政策审查的焦点。短期内资本市场对英伟达的估值逻辑将从单纯的技术增长转向“合规性溢价”与“治理可控性”的重新评估。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The incident marks a transition where leadership risk in the AI sector becomes a national security concern. As the primary backbone of US AI infrastructure, Nvidia’s governance structure will now be subject to heightened regulatory scrutiny, shifting market valuation from pure technical growth to compliance-based risk assessment.

celebrity.author: Yann LeCun
celebrity.author_role_zh: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
celebrity.quote_zh:
@FutureJurvetson @elonmusk @kimmonismus 背景：
“在过去 20 年的大部分时间里，我一直在尝试训练模型进行视频预测，但在前 15 年基本上失败了。直到我意识到必须放弃生成模型并使用联合嵌入预测架构 (JEPA)”

“过去几年，JEPA 和世界模型开始发挥作用。主要应用是物理世界、机器人和工业过程控制。Meta 对这些东西不是特别感兴趣”

但我的项目始终得到扎克、博兹、施雷普和克里斯·考克斯的支持。

确实，作为首席人工智能科学家，我虽然是高级副总裁级别，但却是一名 IC。公司最好的工作！

我从未攻读过法学硕士，这也是事实。我非常支持 FAIR 的 LLM 项目（例如后来成为 Llama 的项目），并在说服 Mark 围绕 Llama 创建人工智能优先产品部门方面发挥了作用，并推动开源 Llama-2。但我从来没有参与过技术层面的工作。
celebrity.quote_en:
@FutureJurvetson @elonmusk @kimmonismus Context:
"I've tried to train models to do video prediction for the better part of the last 20 years, and largely failing for the first 15. Until I realized you had to abandon generative models and use joint embedding predictive architectures (JEPA)" 

"Things started to work in the last few years with JEPA and world models. The main applications are in the physical world, robotics, and industrial process control. Things that Meta is not particularly interested in" 

But my project always had the support of Zuck, Boz, Schrep, and Chris Cox. 

It's true that, as Chief AI Scientist, I was at senior VP level but was an IC. Best job in the company! 

Also true that I never worked on LLMs. I was very supportive of LLM projects at FAIR (e.g. the project that became Llama), and played a role on convincing Mark to create an AI-first product division around Llama, and pushed to open source Llama-2. But I was never involved at the technical level.
celebrity.thesis_zh: 深入探讨世界模型与自监督的关键演进，直指核心工程落地与技术范式转移。
celebrity.thesis_en: Dissecting crucial inflection points in World Models & SSL, highlighting system trade-offs and engineering shifts.

celebrity.debate_en: Global developer community actively debates the broader industry implications.
